text: The person who always agrees with you... might be your biggest risk.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli called flatterers a pest... and said courts are full of them.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: A captain shares his plan. Everyone says... great idea! Nobody mentions the weak defence... until match day.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Take Emperor Maximilian. He kept his plans secret... and asked nobody for advice.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: A man close to him said... He consulted with no one, yet never got his own way in anything.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: His plans came out... his people pushed back... he gave in. Done one day... undone the next.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Shutting people out isn't the answer. Pick wise people... ask them everything... then decide yourself.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The more freely he shall speak... the more he shall be preferred.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Reward whoever brings bad news... and bad news stops hiding.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: This morning, ask someone you trust... what am I getting wrong? Then just listen.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Who always tells you the truth? Shout them out in the comments.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... and keep honest people close.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
